verdict.rationale: Typesense is explicitly open source and provides extensive self-hosting install paths (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Homebrew, DEB/RPM packages, Linux binaries, Terraform module) plus a downloads page stating it 'can be downloaded and run from your computer locally or from any server,' distinct from the separately offered hosted Cloud SaaS. Community comments corroborate real-world self-hosted deployments (memory footprint, running in docker-compose). Missing for 10: independent hands-on production self-hosting case studies at scale and more detail on self-hosted operational parity with Cloud features.
